title: VOXELS: REGROWN
description: This project adds a currency system to trade with creepers and many other stuff!
body:
**THIS MOD WILL ONLY BE AVALILABLE ON MODRINTH AND CURSEFORGE, ANY COPIES ON OTHER WEBSITES ARE NOT REAL**
![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57be8650a3f9f44ce784892352f99ab86f698ece_0.webp)

A remake of an old mod named "Voxels" Which added intelligent creeper civilizations to minecraft: [The original voxels mod link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/voxels)

but the reason why it is being remade (sadly not by the original creator) is because it is for a pretty old version of minecraft

This may not be one to one but it will have some unique features 

sadly tho, idk Java coding so I'm using Mcreator if thats ok

### NOTICE

this is a remake so while the offical mod page for the og version does say all right reserved this is built from the ground up

nothing is stolen from the og voxels mod this mod is just a fan reconstruction of what it would be in 1.21.1

![end](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/44f68ed6962a075a1241453bcf775ebd88aec723_0.webp)
